thread:
sara (Design): quick check: compact heatmap in Insights prototype. Issues: no keyboard focus on cells, tooltips duplicate screen reader output, legend colors are ambiguous for low vision. can we do a short a11y pass?

ben (Eng): i see it. cells are divs with tabindex=0 but global reset removes outline. also no grid semantics.

leo (Accessibility): recommendations: use `role="grid"` / `role="gridcell"`, implement roving tabindex or arrow-key nav, visible focus >=2px, and replace per-cell tooltips with a single status panel that SRs read. legend should include numeric buckets and optional hatch patterns.

nora (PM): timeline: add to next sprint. demos depend on this.

ben (Eng): plan: implement grid roles + JS arrow handlers, add `aria-selected` to active cell, and a small `role="status"` panel below grid that updates on focus. will debounce live announcements 200ms.

sara (Design): UX q: show tooltip visually on focus? i'd prefer a small info panel instead so layout doesn't shift.

leo (Accessibility): info panel is better. make it `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` and keep messages concise (day, hour, value). ensure legend labels meet 4.5:1 contrast and include patterns.

a11y-bot: scan results: missing grid roles, focus outline suppressed => FAIL, legend color warning. Suggested fixes attached.

nora (PM): acceptance criteria: grid semantics + arrow nav, 2px visible focus, single status panel for SR, legend numeric buckets + pattern toggle. target: ship in next release.

ben (Eng): i'll open a draft PR with keyboard tests and axe snapshot. ping when it's ready for review.

sara (Design): thanks team, appreciate the quick follow-up :sparkles:
